mapper.select: SELECT C.REPORT_TYPE_NO AS CODE_NO, NVL(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(C.REPORT_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), C.REPORT_NO) AS REPORT_NAME, C.URL_JSP FROM REPORT_CENTER C, SY_CODE T WHERE T.CODE_NO = C.REPORT_TYPE_NO AND T.PARENT_CODE_NO = 14015405 AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY T.ORDERNO, C.ORDERNO, C.REPORT_TYPE_NO
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(${col}, '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(${col})) ELSE 0 END
mapper.select:
SELECT G.DIM1 AS DIM_KEY,
GET_GLOBAL_NAME(G.DIM1, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DIM_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME((SELECT SC.PARENT_CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE SC WHERE SC.CODE_NO = G.DIM1 AND ROWNUM = 1), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME,
GET_GLOBAL_NAME(G.DIM1, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DIM_NAME, NULL AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME,
GET_DEPT_NAME(G.DIM1, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DIM_NAME, NULL AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME,
SUBSTR(G.DIM1, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(G.DIM1, 1, 4) AS DIM_NAME, NULL AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME,
G.DIM1 AS DIM_NAME, NULL AS TRAIN_DIFF_NAME,
G.DIM2 AS COURSE_NAME_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(G.FORM_KEY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_NAME, G.COURSE_COUNT, G.CLASS_COUNT, G.NUMB, G.PERSON_COUNT, ROUND(G.NUMB / NULLIF(G.PERSON_COUNT, 0), 2) AS AVG_COUNT, ROUND(G.ALL_TIME, 2) AS ALL_TIME, ROUND(G.TOTAL_PT, 2) AS TOTAL_PT, ROUND(G.TOTAL_PT / NULLIF(G.NUMB, 0), 2) AS AVG_TIME, ROUND(G.DIRECT_COST + G.INDIRECT_COST, 2) AS ALL_COST, ROUND(G.DIRECT_COST, 2) AS DIRECT_COST, ROUND(G.INDIRECT_COST, 2) AS INDIRECT_COST, ROUND((G.DIRECT_COST + G.INDIRECT_COST) / NULLIF(G.NUMB, 0), 2) AS AVG_COST FROM (SELECT C.DIM1, C.DIM2, C.FORM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT C.COURSE_NO) AS COURSE_COUNT, COUNT(1) AS CLASS_COUNT, SUM(C.CNT) AS NUMB, SUM(C.PERSONS) AS PERSON_COUNT, SUM(C.HOURS) AS ALL_TIME, SUM(C.HOURS * C.CNT) AS TOTAL_PT, SUM(C.DIRECT_COST) AS DIRECT_COST, SUM(C.INDIRECT_COST) AS INDIRECT_COST FROM (SELECT T.DIM1, T.DIM2, T.FORM_KEY, T.BASIC_NO, MAX(T.COURSE_NO) AS COURSE_NO, MAX(T.HOURS) AS HOURS, COUNT(T.EMPID) AS CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN T.RN = 1 AND T.EMPID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PERSONS, SUM(T.DIRECT_COST / GREATEST(T.BS_NUMB, 1)) AS DIRECT_COST, SUM(T.INDIRECT_COST / GREATEST(T.BS_NUMB, 1)) AS INDIRECT_COST FROM (SELECT X.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X.DIM1, X.DIM2, X.FORM_KEY, X.EMPID ORDER BY X.BASIC_NO) AS RN FROM (SELECT BS.BASIC_NO, BS.COURSE_NO, BS.HOURS, BS.DIRECT_COST, BS.INDIRECT_COST, BS.BS_NUMB, F.EMPID,
BS.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE AS DIM1, BS.COURSE_NAME_CODE AS DIM2, BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS FORM_KEY H.POST_GRADE_NO AS DIM1, NULL AS DIM2, BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS FORM_KEY H.DEPTNO AS DIM1, NULL AS DIM2, BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS FORM_KEY TO_CHAR(BS.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYY') AS DIM1, NULL AS DIM2, BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS FORM_KEY TO_CHAR(BS.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYYMM') AS DIM1, NULL AS DIM2, BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS FORM_KEY BS.TRAIN_FORM_CODE AS DIM1, NULL AS DIM2, NULL AS FORM_KEY
FROM (SELECT B.BASIC_NO, P.COURSE_NO, P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, B.IMPLE_START_DATE,
* CASE B.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT WHEN '2' THEN 1 WHEN '1' THEN 8 WHEN '0' THEN 240 ELSE 0 END AS HOURS,
+ + AS DIRECT_COST,
+ + + + AS INDIRECT_COST, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F2 WHERE F2.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO AND F2.ACTIVITY = '1') AS BS_NUMB FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = B.PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_COST_MANAGER M ON M.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO AND M.ACTIVITY = 1 WHERE B.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.ACTIVITY = '1'
AND P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT SC.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE SC WHERE SC.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{trainDiffCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE = #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(P.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND TO_CHAR(B.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = #{month, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND P.TRAIN_FORM_CODE = #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
) BS LEFT JOIN EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F ON F.BASIC_NO = BS.BASIC_NO AND F.ACTIVITY = '1' LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.EMPID = F.EMPID WHERE 1 = 1
AND F.EMPID IS NOT NULL
AND UPPER(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{postGradeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND H.DEPTNO IN (SELECT D.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
) X ) T GROUP BY T.DIM1, T.DIM2, T.FORM_KEY, T.BASIC_NO ) C GROUP BY C.DIM1, C.DIM2, C.FORM_KEY ) G ORDER BY G.DIM1, G.DIM2, TRAIN_FORM_NAME
